title: 1 in 10 Malaysian Men Borrow Money to Pay for Dates
paragraphs: Going on a date can be expensive. In Malaysia, some men even borrow money to pay for their dates, according to a new study.

The study was done by Legasi Research, a research organization in Malaysia. It shared the results at a news conference in Kuala Lumpur on October 27, 2026. The researchers collected 152 useful answers from people in different parts of the country. More than half of them lived in Kuala Lumpur or the state of Selangor.
The study found that 13.2% of men said they would borrow money to pay for a date. That is more than one in ten men. Only 4.9% of women said the same.
Men also usually pay for dates. About 59.3% of men said they normally pay the whole bill. Only 8.2% of women said this. Some couples take turns paying.

Most of the money goes on food and drinks. A typical date costs between 51 and 200 Malaysian ringgit. Shopping malls, cafes and restaurants are the most popular places for dates. About half of the people in the study said dating is expensive.
Dating costs can also cause stress. About 27.5% of men said they feel pressure because of the cost of dating, compared with 16.4% of women.

Firdzan Nur Yassin, a researcher at Legasi Research, said the results show that most men still pay for dates. This shows that many people still follow traditional ideas about men's and women's roles in dating.
However, the study was small, so the results may not show the situation for the whole country.
